name: partner-scorecard
title: Partner scorecard
for_each: select p.id, p.name from partners p where p.state='active' order by p.name

sections.title: Tier
sections.sql: select current_tier, revenue_12m, currency, certified_now, status, detail, next_tier, revenue_to_next, certified_to_next from tier_status where id=$1

sections.title: Deal registrations, last 12 months
sections.sql: select state, count(*) as registrations, sum(value) as value from registrations where partner_id=$1 and submitted_on>current_date-365 group by state order by state

sections.title: Open registrations
sections.sql: select reference, end_customer, value, expires_on from registrations where partner_id=$1 and state='approved' and expires_on>=current_date order by expires_on

sections.title: Market development funds
sections.sql: select period_start, period_end, allocated, committed, paid, available from mdf_position where id in (select id from mdf_funds where partner_id=$1)

sections.title: Certified people
sections.sql: select c.name, x.name as certification, x.expires_on from certifications x join contacts c on c.id=x.contact_id where c.partner_id=$1 and x.expires_on>=current_date order by x.expires_on

name: registration-confirmation
title: Deal registration confirmation
for_each: select id, reference||' '||end_customer as name from registrations where state='approved' and expires_on>=current_date order by reference

sections.title: Registration
sections.sql: select r.reference, p.name as partner, r.end_customer, r.description, p.currency, r.value from registrations r join partners p on p.id=r.partner_id where r.id=$1

sections.title: Protection
sections.note: The registration protects this opportunity for the partner until the date below. Ask for an extension before it ends.
sections.sql: select submitted_on, decided_on as approved_on, decided_by as approved_by, expires_on as protected_until from registrations where id=$1

name: mdf-remittance
title: Market development funds remittance
for_each: select id, reference as name from mdf_requests where state='paid' order by paid_on

sections.title: Activity
sections.sql: select m.reference, p.name as partner, m.activity, m.planned_on, m.proof from mdf_requests m join mdf_funds f on f.id=m.fund_id join partners p on p.id=f.partner_id where m.id=$1

sections.title: Payment
sections.sql: select p.currency, m.requested_amount as pre_approved, m.claimed_amount as claimed, m.approved_amount as paid, m.paid_on, m.payment_ref, coalesce(m.tax_invoice_ref,'Not on file') as your_tax_invoice from mdf_requests m join mdf_funds f on f.id=m.fund_id join partners p on p.id=f.partner_id where m.id=$1

sections.title: Results reported
sections.sql: select leads, pipeline from mdf_requests where id=$1
